skills.description: Back up an iPhone over USB on Linux without sudo, as a full or incremental encrypted iTunes-style backup plus an add-only photo archive, onto an external disk. Use when asked to back up an iPhone, update an iPhone backup, archive iPhone photos, or pull photos out of an iPhone backup.
